text:
Alice M: quick deploy finished to /stable at 14:02 PT. Rolling canary -> full. can people do a quick verification sweep? focus on latency, 5xxs, and auth errors. I'll be around for 30m. @Ben P @Clara (platform) @Dan S

Ben P: smoke ran: basic health endpoints ok, small error rate on /generate ~0.2% (baseline 0.05%). watching.

Clara (platform): saw p95 token latency +18% on a subset of pods, looks like batcher queued more requests during canary. Metrics: `redwood.latency.p95` spike to 430ms. Prefetch caches warming.

Dan S: did config tweak — bump `MAX_BATCH_MS` from 8->6 for canary, restarted 3 replicas.

deploy-bot: deploy redwood/serve@v3.2.9 -> stable :white_check_mark: canary->full at 2411112225

Ben P: after restart p95 back to 360ms, error rate down to 0.03%. I'll keep watch for 15m.

Alice M: sounds good. Rolling back plan (if 5xx > 0.5% for 5m OR p95 >800ms) — @Dan S you'll trigger `redwood rollback stable`?

Dan S: yep, ready. quick ack with steps:
```
1) run `redwood rollback stable --to v3.2.8`
2) monitor : `curl /health` and `kubectl get pods -l app=serve`
3) notify #eng-releases
```

Clara (platform): minor follow-up — we should add a canary metric alert rule for `batcher.queue_length > 50` to prevent this in future.

Alice M: yup, file a quick RFC PR. thanks everyone — closing thread unless anything else.

Ben P: LGTM :thumbsup:
